title: Act: Register admin execution routes from the same table
summary: Add adminExecutionRoutes(eh) and register it through a combined adminRoutes function.
description: Move execution registrations into the table and expose one adminRoutes(eh, rh) that tests can call.
acceptance_criteria: adminRoutes returns eight routes: five round and three execution.
Execution routes keep their paths and methods.

steps.action: Add func adminRoutes(eh *execution.Handler, rh *admin.RoundHandler) []adminRoute returning GET /executions (eh.List), POST /executions/{id}/retry (eh.Retry), POST /executions/{id}/approve (eh.Approve) followed by adminRoundRoutes(rh).
Replace the loop over adminRoundRoutes(rh) and the three inline ar.Get/ar.Post execution registrations with one loop over adminRoutes(eh, rh).
steps.expected: All eight routes still mounted behind admin.Middleware.
